about.summary: I'm a Backend Engineer with over five years of experience building and evolving scalable systems for fintech, banking, enterprise and media platforms. I specialize in Node.js and TypeScript, designing cloud-native services on AWS and Azure using serverless, microservice, event-driven and distributed architectures. My work spans enterprise APIs, financial integrations, video-processing workflows, observability, automated testing and code-quality practices. I have contributed to technical decisions, backend modernization and team leadership while keeping reliability, security and maintainability central to delivery. I focus on practical architecture: systems that are clear to operate, resilient in production and aligned with real business requirements.

experience.intro: Backend engineering experience across financial services, distributed media platforms and full-stack product development.

ficohsa.summary: Developing and modernizing backend services for financial platforms, including lending and extra-financing systems, within a serverless Azure environment.
achievements: Design and maintain backend services and integrations supporting financial product workflows.
Contribute to serverless architecture and system modernization using Azure Functions, NestJS and TypeScript.
Strengthen reliability and maintainability through unit testing, code analysis and security validation practices.
Implement observability and operational alerting with Application Insights.
Participate in backend technical decisions and leadership responsibilities within agile teams.

toolbox.summary: Built and led backend work for cloud-based media processing and streaming platforms serving major entertainment clients.
achievements: Developed distributed backend services and microservices for media ingestion, processing and delivery workflows.
Designed and evolved AWS-based services supporting scalable video encoding and transcoding operations.
Worked with HLS and DASH workflows, FFmpeg and multiple file transfer protocols.
Contributed to the modernization of a legacy Java monolith into maintainable backend services.
Provided technical leadership and supported backend team responsibilities, architecture decisions and delivery.

posicionarte.summary: Started my professional career building web applications across frontend and backend, establishing the foundation for later backend specialization.
achievements: Developed web application features with Angular, React and Node.js.
Built and integrated APIs backed by Firebase and Firestore.

financial-backend-platforms.title: Financial Backend Platforms
financial-backend-platforms.shortDescription: Backend services for financial products, enterprise integrations and critical operational workflows.
financial-backend-platforms.context: Financial platforms supporting lending and extra-financing products.
financial-backend-platforms.problem: Financial products depend on backend workflows that must remain reliable as integrations, data sources and operational requirements evolve. The challenge was to build and modernize services while preserving security, maintainability and visibility into production behavior.
financial-backend-platforms.contribution: I contributed to the design and evolution of backend services, enterprise APIs and serverless workflows. My work included data integration, caching, resilience, automated testing, security and code-quality controls, observability, and participation in backend technical decisions and leadership responsibilities.
financial-backend-platforms.outcome: The work supported more maintainable and reliable backend workflows, stronger operational visibility, and safer delivery practices through testing, security validation and code-quality controls.

cloud-video-processing-streaming.title: Cloud Video Processing & Streaming
cloud-video-processing-streaming.shortDescription: Distributed backend workflows for processing and delivering audiovisual content through cloud platforms.
cloud-video-processing-streaming.context: Media platforms serving major entertainment clients.
cloud-video-processing-streaming.problem: Media platforms need to ingest, process and distribute audiovisual content through complex workflows across cloud services and external transfer systems. These workloads require coordinated backend jobs, reliable encoding and transcoding, and enough operational visibility to support production processing.
cloud-video-processing-streaming.contribution: I built backend services and microservices for media ingestion, processing and delivery, working with distributed jobs, object storage, containerized services, CDN delivery and video pipelines. I also integrated file-transfer systems, contributed to observability and legacy workflow modernization, and provided technical leadership within the backend team.
cloud-video-processing-streaming.outcome: This work supported scalable content processing, reusable backend services, better operational visibility and more maintainable media-processing workflows as legacy components evolved.

serverless-backend-architecture.title: Serverless Backend Architecture
serverless-backend-architecture.shortDescription: A cross-company capability for building decoupled, event-driven backend services on AWS and Azure.
serverless-backend-architecture.context: Enterprise backend systems across AWS and Azure.
serverless-backend-architecture.problem: Enterprise backend systems often need to scale individual workloads and integrations without carrying unnecessary infrastructure overhead. The architectural challenge is to keep functions, APIs, events and workflows decoupled while retaining clear security boundaries, observability and operational ownership.
serverless-backend-architecture.contribution: Across production environments, I have worked on functions and services, API layers, event-driven communication, workflow orchestration and asynchronous processing. I have also contributed to infrastructure as code, permissions and security, monitoring, logging, reliability practices and maintainable service boundaries.
serverless-backend-architecture.outcome: These patterns supported clearer service boundaries, independent deployment, scalable event processing, reduced infrastructure overhead and improved operational visibility.
